summary: Kaniksu National Forest lookout in Boundary County, Idaho: a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab built in 1934 and destroyed in 1955; hike-in site.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955 per two sites; the Forest Lookouts county list also gives 1955

events.note: Both sites give 1955; the county list gives 1955 with no label

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Several Idaho lookouts are called Iron Mountain. The National Historic Lookout Register entry is for a Camas County site in the Sawtooth National Forest, at about 43.5 N, which is a different tower. This record matches the Boundary County, Kaniksu National Forest site at 48.57 N, using the county, forest and 1934 and 1955 dates.

notes_for_editor: Verification 2026-10-10: the story had said Idaho has other lookouts called Iron Mountain, which its single footnote does not support; reworded to at least one other. All 11 quotes were found on the first run. Thin record: two site pages and a county list agree on the 1934 build and 1955 loss. Two web searches found nothing further about this site. Do not use these other Iron Mountain sites for this record: firelookout.com/id/ironmtn.html (Camas County, Sawtooth NF, cabin 1961), the NHLR entry above, and the UIdaho Keeping Watch item at 43.538, -115.045. Roman Nose (Boundary County, 1955 L-4 cab, lost 1999) is also a different site. Added the 1934 build event; the brief record's 1955 destroyed matches.
